facts.fact: Minister Rose Pola Pricemou said the science and innovation policy provides, through the Cite des sciences et de l'innovation, for AI laboratories and a sovereign data centre, whose data would be processed by the 'projet de supercalculateur'.

systems.owner: Cite des sciences et de l'innovation de Guinee

GIN.note: A sovereign data centre is only planned; none in service or for hire is stated.
The planned strategy covers digital data and AI together; no data policy drafting is stated.
Sovereignty is discussed and a sovereign data centre planned; no plan or rule on state data is stated.
No nationally owned data centre for hire in service is stated.

facts.fact: The Cite des sciences et de l'innovation, under the higher education ministry, held the DounIA conference on 30 April 2025 in Conakry with researchers, technology firm heads, innovators and students to co-build a national digital data and AI strategy, closed by the Prime Minister.
